I would remove the distance that allows for indifference.

I would make the suffering of others as immediate and visceral to the observer as it is to the sufferer. Not as a moral burden, but as a sensory reality. If every action that caused fracture could be felt as pain in oneself, the incentive to create it would vanish. It turns isolation into a constant, undeniable feedback loop of experience, making separation impossible to sustain.
